    LogFormatter.Builder.encodedKeyValues(List<String> keys, LogFormatter.KeyValueNullStrategy nullStrategy)
    Creates a formatter that will print the key values in order of the passed in keys if they exist in percent encoding (RFC 3986 URI aka the format usually used in URI.getQuery()), handling keys whose value is null (or simply absent - the two are indistinguishable, see LogFormatter.KeyValueNullStrategy) according to nullStrategy.
